our_interpretation: Zero percent refers to the reported synthetic name-to-description reversal result, not every model and every direction in the paper.
Dismal means substantially worse reverse recall than forward recall on the celebrity task; Marcus supplies no numerical threshold.
The target is the cited experiments completed before the September 2023 post, with execution dates identified only to the year.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The claimed synthetic result is not zero, or celebrity reverse performance is high and comparable to forward performance.
